attempts.prompt:
CACE Imatges, school-friendly wordless educational narrative. Deliver one wide landscape image. EXACTLY FOUR equal vertical panels in ONE horizontal row from left to right, with pure white margins and three consistent white gutters. Never merge panels, use a second row, crop the first or last panel or insert an inset panel. Clear simplified setting against white with only needed cues. Medium-wide full-action views, eye-level slightly oblique, matching camera position, perspective, dimensions, anatomy, scale, lighting, hair/fur, clothes and object shapes across panels. Repeat the same two characters scene to scene. Favor visual evidence of their actions, visible distinct hands and physical points of contact. No cut-off hands, warped fingers, floating objects, implausible contact, lettering, branding, numbers, panel labels, arrows, speech bubbles, captions or motion graphics. The internal codes A and B are directions only. Preserve every count and all patterns. Stage the action as a natural coherent story.
Exactly two bipedal anthropomorphic animals with consistent functional paws or hands. Flat educational illustration, simple clean color shapes and smooth dark outlines, flat colors only, white-background context.

Flat two-dimensional cartoon. Exactly two anthropomorphic animal characters.
Cast: A is CONILL, armilla blau fosc amb un triangle clar al davant; B is GAT, samarreta ocre amb dues ratlles blanques al davant.
A rabbit brings water; a cat waters the two potted plants. Fixed camera; the TWO single pots, with respectively pointed leaves in a red pot and round leaves in a yellow pot, stay alone in the foreground. The bucket sits on a low blue bench behind and well to the left, far from the pots, and has a clearly decreasing waterline. P1 rabbit carrying half-full bucket, cat points down to both pots with pale dry soil. P2 rabbit sets bucket on bench, cat lifts a tiny blue watering can just dipped into bucket, same two dry pots visible. P3 the rabbit has slid the yellow pot a little closer; cat now aims a thin continuous water stream down FROM CAN SPOUT directly ONTO visibly moist SOIL in yellow pot, left red pot is already moist. The bucket is out of the path of the stream. P4 both pots now dark wet soil; cat hands empty blue can to rabbit, water bucket remains nearly empty on left. Absolutely two pots only and nothing else leafy. Tiny low vegetable bed in distant background establishes school garden without extra pots.
attempts.review: Els dos testos, de color i fulla diferents, es conserven. La galleda mostra menys aigua, la terra dels dos testos s’enfosqueix i el gat retorna la regadora al conill.

alt.ca: El conill porta una galleda d’aigua. El gat omple una regadora, rega els dos testos amb l’ajuda del conill i li torna la regadora.
alt.es: El conejo trae un cubo con agua. El gato llena una regadera, riega las dos macetas con la ayuda del conejo y le devuelve la regadera.
